entities.summary: Dibble is a town in McClain County, Oklahoma, United States. The population of the town was 867 at the 2020 census. Dibble is in the Oklahoma City Metropolitan Area, according to the U.S. Census, within the outer suburban area west of Purcell and southwest of Norman.
